page.content:
Ranette is a gunsmith on Scadrial who makes many of the guns used by Wax. She shelters them and inspecthumbts one of the Vanishers' aluminum pistols. She identifies it as being made by Nouxil.

page.overview:
Who is Ranette?

Ranette is a gunsmith on Scadrial who makes many of the guns used by Wax. She shelters them and inspecthumbts one of the Vanishers' aluminum pistols. She identifies it as being made by Nouxil.

She lived in the Roughs but moved to the city some time before Wax did due to the use of electricity in the city, despite disliking Elendel and feeling unsafe there. Her home is located in the Third Octant. It is a red brick house and has two stories.
